title: 第37章 真相只有一个！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “怎么了，急急忙忙的催我回来？”高峰抽空回老部队办点事儿，何镇涛忽然打电话催促他赶紧回来。在电话里追问情况，还不肯说，非得回来了再讲。整的他火急火燎的，差点因为超速把路边执勤的纠察给招来。连部楼下，何镇涛已经提前在等着了，甚至还主动帮他把车门拉开。“怎么了，啥事了啊？”“出了小点状况。”“小状况？”“走，去我办公室。”二人迈着小碎步上楼。高峰却格外好奇：“到底什么事，整搞得这么神秘？不会是知道我快过生日，提前给我弄个什么惊喜吧？”何镇涛可没这心情跟他说笑：“是丁腾飞又闯祸了。”“具体点？”“他偷了点东西，被炊事班逮个正着，人赃并获。”“他奶奶的，真是狗改不了吃屎。亏我还以为这小子转性子了，没找到居然是个烟雾弹？”高峰气的不行：“偷的什么，严重吗？”“炒面。”“炒面？”高峰手刚搭在把手上准备推门进去，忽然停下动作。扭过头，有些莫名其妙的看向身旁的何镇涛。“什么炒面，海参炒面？”“就是入伍第一顿，给新兵们忆苦思甜的炒面粉，外加两瓶临期牛奶。”“那小子不是吃不惯吗，他偷那东西干什么？”何镇涛两手一摊：“我也不清楚，这只能问他了。”高峰拧着眉头，思索片刻后推门和指导员一起走进去。办公室里，丁腾飞正红着眼眶，肩膀一抽一抽的站在墙角罚站。身上，帽子上，头发上，还沾着淡淡的米色粉末，也让屋子里多了一股淡淡的炒熟后的谷物香气。……“班长。”“班长？”傍晚的食堂里，新兵们正在吃饭。正如之前孔垄预料的那样，今晚餐桌上有韭黄炒鸡蛋。这是一道不输给蒜薹炒肉的下饭菜，也是每个战士的心头好，拌饭一绝。可今回大家却吃的格外拘谨，就连周凯东都似乎有点发愣走神。陆阳喊了两声，班长这才回过神，问他怎么了？“班长，要不要盛汤？”“哦，好的。”汤靠挨着陆阳这边近，所以他会顺手给坐的远的盛汤，也就省得对方站起来了。陆阳盛了满满一碗西红柿鸡蛋汤，递给周凯东。“谢谢。”“不客气。”二人的回答，让饭桌上的其他人动作都停顿了一下，忍不住面面相觑。以往帮班长盛饭，盛汤，递筷子，班长都是嗯一声，或是点个头意思一下。这么正式的说谢谢，好像还是头一回。这种忽然间的客气，让大家莫名觉得有些疏远和不适应。像极了某个很熟络的朋友，突然之间变得很正式，变得很客气。这时，孔垄等人忽然压低声音，悄悄问向陆阳。“班副，丁腾飞究竟为啥要偷炒面？”“他又吃不惯那个，还偷偷往回拿，图啥呀？”“又干又拉嗓子，不喝水根本下不去，他为啥非得偷这玩意儿，苹果橘子不香吗？”陆阳没有回答，而是让大家吃饭，不要去想这些有的没的。但其实，他心里已经有了猜测，但没法儿讲出来。并且陆阳相信，班长内心也有了相同的猜想。也正是这个猜想，让他十分懊悔先前的举动，后悔对丁腾飞做出那么过激的举动，甚至说出那样难听的话。可偏偏就在这时，脑袋一向不怎么灵光的孔垄，忽然像是开窍了一样。“你们说，有没有一种可能？”“我是说假如，假定，假设，丁腾飞有没有可能是因为……”陆阳在桌子底下踢了他一下，提醒他不要乱说。但孔垄却像个铁憨憨一样，直接问向陆阳。“你用脚扒拉我干啥？”“没有啊？”“不是你？那谁扒拉的我？”孔垄疑惑的低头朝着桌子底下，陆阳见此情景也是满脸无语。这个猜测不是不能说，而是最好不要现在，尤其是当众讲出来。因为对于周凯东来说，这会是一次公开处刑。很多事，不是非黑即白，也不是一定非得分个对错。如果猜想最终被证实了，那周凯东会处在一个非常尴尬的位置。他在应该表扬的时候，错误的去打击羞辱了一个兵的自尊心，也必定会深感自责愧疚。除非，这个猜想是错误的……但陆阳觉得，大概率不可能。以往不论是抽烟被提干，还是犯错误被关禁闭，丁腾飞一次都没哭过。偏偏这次班长并没有真正动手，只是说了几句狠话，他就哭的那么伤心。除了委屈，陆阳实在想不出什么其他原因。至于，他为什么会感到委屈和难受……“真相只有一个……”孔垄眼里闪烁着智慧的光芒，大胆假设：“他肯定是想用那玩意儿，来偷偷换掉我的蛋白粉！蛋白粉这东西，谁能不馋，谁能不惦记？”陆阳嘴角抽了抽，他多少有点儿高估孔垄的智商了。孔垄要是能想到这个层面，大脑起码得开发到百分之九十九，得用几十斤腱子肉来换！其他人纷纷点头，觉得孔垄说的很道理。也有人猜测，他这么做可能是想将食堂炒面全部销毁，防止再来一次忆苦思甜。甚至有人说，丁腾飞这么做就是为了故意戏耍那个上等兵。谁让那家伙故意找茬刁难，还像盯梢一样看着陆阳他们干活的？“那如果丁腾飞只拿了点儿炒面，问题应该也不算太严重吧？”“咱也偷过鸡蛋，馒头，我还偷偷多拿过一瓶牛奶，真要是追究起来可比他严重多了。”“所以，我很好奇，炊事班丢了的那些东西，到底是谁偷的？”“难不成，咱们新兵连真的闹小偷不成？”……“你说说你们，你说说你们？”后厨，灶台上已经偃旗息鼓，该收拾的卫生也收拾干净了。司务长指着面前这一帮炊事班老兵，气不打一处来。“我就外出办点儿事，给团里送了点儿东西，你们就给我惹了这么大麻烦？”“司务长，不能怨我们，都是那个丁腾飞……”上等兵刘诚刚要开口，就被司务长强行打断。“你别跟我说这些，我就问你，就一袋炒面两瓶临期牛奶的事，有没有必要搞得兴师动众，满城风雨？”“就算他拿的不是炒面，换成苹果橘子香蕉，又能怎么样？”“咱们这是食堂，不是弹药库，不是军械库！咱们存在的意义就是让战士们吃饱吃好，有力气训练，而不是在这像防贼一样凡事上纲上线！”司务长拍着案板，气呼呼的：“那个六班的新兵来帮忙，哪回不是怀里塞的满满当当回去，跟进货似的，我说什么了？”刘诚尴尬的解释：“报告，那不一样。”“哪儿不一样？”“六班小周有厨师证的，他以后会是咱炊事班的人，所以……”“所以就可以睁一只眼闭一只眼，所以就可以区别对待，所以一个干了一下午活，把仓库收拾的整整齐齐的就是小偷，另一个就不是了？”司务长调门瞬间拔高，刘诚连忙闭嘴，不敢再说话。他拍着心口，痛心疾首的说：“同志们，我很心痛，我很痛心呐！”“就为了那么点小事，你们硬生生把一个新兵给按在垃圾场角落里，还上下其手的搜身，这和街头混混有什么区别？”“你们，全都得给我好好反省，好好反思，尤其是你！”刘诚是哑巴吃黄连，有苦说不出。原以为能闹个表扬奖励，却没想到挨了一顿骂。遭受无妄之灾的其他老兵此刻恨死这家伙了，要不是他咋咋呼呼的喊偷东西了，他们哪会追上去？但有一点，他们始终想不明白，藏在坛子里的东西到底被谁偷了？司务长问：“对了，你们先前说丢东西，丢的是什么？”炊事班长连忙说：“好几部手机，mp4，还有两包烟。”“这些东西不是都上交了吗，你们怎么还有？”“额，这个……”老兵们支支吾吾，明显是紧张心虚。司务长露出冷笑，立马明白这帮家伙全都违规藏匿了电子产品。难怪先前一个个那么激动，这是怕东窗事发了，被连长指导员责骂。“东西藏哪儿的，怎么丢的？”“我们把东西全藏在仓库泡菜坛子里了，眨眼的工夫说没就没了。”“泡菜坛子，哪个泡菜坛子？”“就是角落里腌萝卜咸菜那十几个坛子，不是有几个空着吗？我们有点啥不能不能见光的都放那里头，上回团副正委来检查，就是这么逃过一劫的。”听到这话的司务长先是一愣，随后一拍脑袋，急的直跳脚。“哎呀，你们啊，你们啊，真是把我害惨了！”“我下午专门去给团里领导送咸菜，随手就抱了两坛就去了！”“啥？你，你给团领导送去了？？？”老兵们人麻了，纷纷追问是送给团里哪位领导，还能不能追回来？司务长急得抓耳挠腮，刚送去又要回来，那不是此地无银三百两吗？但最终他还是选择赌一把，准备再度登门以咸菜变质，没腌制好为由看看能不能拿回来？就在司务长带着炊事班长，紧赶慢赶的开车过去时，团部机关二楼的值班室里。负责战备值班的副正委谭元洲，一手端着稀饭，一手举着筷子。看见泡菜坛子里头的手机和mp4，露出一副匪夷所思，无法理解，却又大受震撼的表情......
content_en: "What's the matter, are you urging me to come back in a hurry?" Gao Feng took some time to go back to his old army to do some errands, and He Zhentao suddenly called and urged him to come back quickly.When I asked about the situation on the phone, I still refused to talk about it and had to talk about it when I got back.He was so anxious that he almost called the picket on the roadside for speeding.Downstairs at the company headquarters, He Zhentao was already waiting in advance, and even took the initiative to open the car door for him."What's wrong? What's going on?" "Something happened." "Something happened?" "Let's go to my office." The two of them took small steps upstairs.Gao Feng was particularly curious: "What on earth is so mysterious? You know that my birthday is coming soon, so you want to surprise me in advance?" He Zhentao was not in the mood to joke with him: "It was Ding Tengfei who got into trouble again." "Be specific?" "He stole something and was caught by the cooking class."His grandma can't change his mind. I thought this kid had changed his mind, but he was a smoke bomb?"Gao Feng was so angry: "What did you steal?""Fried noodles?"Gao Feng put his hand on the handle and was about to push the door in, when he suddenly stopped.He turned his head and looked at He Zhentao beside him inexplicably."What fried noodles, sea cucumber fried noodles?" "It's the first meal in the army, fried flour for the recruits to remember the bitterness and sweetness, plus two bottles of milk." "Isn't that kid not used to it? Why did he steal that thing?" He Zhentao spread his hands: "I don't know, I can only ask him." Gao Feng frowned, thought for a moment, opened the door and walked in with the instructor.In the office, Ding Tengfei was standing in the corner with red eyes and twitching shoulders.There was a faint beige powder on his body, hat, and hair, which also gave the room a faint aroma of fried grains...."Squad leader." "Squad leader?" In the cafeteria in the evening, the recruits were eating.Just as Kong Long expected, there will be scrambled eggs with chives on the table tonight.This is a side dish that is not inferior to the stir-fried pork with garlic sprouts. It is also every soldier’s favorite and is a must-have with rice.But this time everyone ate with extra restraint, and even Zhou Kaidong seemed a little dazed and distracted.Lu Yang shouted twice, and then the squad leader came back to his senses and asked him what was wrong?"Squad leader, do you want some soup?" "Oh, okay." The soup is closer to Lu Yang, so he will serve the soup to the person sitting far away, which saves him from having to stand up.Lu Yang filled a bowl of tomato and egg soup and handed it to Zhou Kaidong."Thank you." "You're welcome." The two replied, causing everyone else at the dinner table to pause and couldn't help but look at each other.In the past, when I helped the squad leader with rice, soup, and chopsticks, the squad leader would always respond with a "hmm" or a nod.It seems like this is the first time I say thank you so formally.This sudden politeness made everyone feel a little alienated and uncomfortable for no reason.It's like a very close friend suddenly becomes very formal and very polite.At this time, Kong Long and others suddenly lowered their voices and asked Lu Yang quietly."Shift deputy, why did Ding Tengfei steal the fried noodles?" "He couldn't get used to eating that, so he took it back secretly. What was he doing?" "It's dry and throaty, and he can't go down without drinking water. Why did he have to steal this thing? Don't apples and oranges taste good?" Lu Yang did not answer, but asked everyone to eat and not think about whether these things are there or not.But in fact, he already had a guess in his mind, but he couldn't express it.And Lu Yang believed that the squad leader also had the same suspicion in his heart.It was this conjecture that made him regret his previous actions, regret that he had done such an extreme thing to Ding Tengfei, and even said such unpleasant words.But just at this moment, Kong Long, who had never been very smart, suddenly seemed to have an enlightenment."Do you think there is a possibility?" "I mean if, if, if, if, it is possible that Ding Tengfei is because..." Lu Yang kicked him under the table to remind him not to talk nonsense.But Kong Long asked Lu Yang directly like a fool."Why are you pulling me with your feet?" "No?" "Not you? Then who pulled me?" Kong Long lowered his head under the table in confusion, and Lu Yang was speechless when he saw this scene.It’s not that this guess can’t be said, but it’s better not to say it now, especially in public.Because for Zhou Kaidong, this would be a public execution.Many things are not black and white, nor do they necessarily have to be right or wrong.If the suspicion is finally confirmed, Zhou Kaidong will be in a very embarrassing position.When he should be praised, he mistakenly attacked and humiliated a soldier's self-esteem, and he would definitely feel deeply guilty.Unless, this guess is wrong... But Lu Yang feels that it is highly unlikely.In the past, whether he was raped for smoking or imprisoned for making mistakes, Ding Tengfei never cried once.But this time the squad leader didn't really take action, he just said a few harsh words, and he cried so sadly.Apart from grievance, Lu Yang really couldn't think of any other reason.As for why he felt wronged and uncomfortable... "There is only one truth..." Kong Long's eyes flashed with wisdom, and he boldly assumed: "He must be using that thing to secretly replace my protein powder! Who can not be greedy for protein powder, and who can not miss it?" The corner of Lu Yang's mouth twitched, he somewhat overestimated Kong Long's IQ.If Kong Long could think of this level, his brain would have to be developed to at least 99%, and he would have to spend dozens of kilograms of shank meat in exchange for it!Others nodded, feeling that what Kong Long said made sense.Some people also speculated that he might have done this to destroy all the fried noodles in the cafeteria to prevent another incident.Some people even said that Ding Tengfei did this just to deliberately tease the superior soldier.Who told that guy to deliberately create trouble and watch Lu Yang and the others working like a stalker?"Then if Ding Tengfei only took some fried noodles, the problem shouldn't be too serious, right?" "We also stole eggs and steamed buns, and I also secretly took an extra bottle of milk. If we were to pursue it, it would be much more serious than him." "So, I'm curious, cookingWho stole the things that the class lost?""Is it possible that our recruit company is really a thief?"... "Tell me about you, tell me about you?" The kitchen and the stove have all been cleaned up.The chief of staff pointed at the group of veterans in the cooking class in front of him and became very angry."I just went out to do some errands and delivered some things to the regiment, and why did you cause so much trouble for me?" "Chief Secretary, you can't blame us, it's all that Ding Tengfei..." Private Liu Cheng was about to speak, but was forcibly interrupted by the Chief Secretary."Don't tell me this, let me ask you, is it necessary to cause a stir and uproar in the city over a bag of fried noodles and two bottles of expired milk?" "What if he didn't bring fried noodles but replaced them with apples, oranges and bananas?" "We are in the cafeteria.It's not an ammunition depot, it's not an armory!The purpose of our existence is to keep the soldiers well-fed and strong enough to train, not to do everything on the line like guarding against thieves!" The chief of staff slapped the chopping board and angrily said, "Why don't those recruits from squad six come to help?He went back with his arms full, as if he were following up on the goods, what did I say?" Liu Cheng explained awkwardly: "Report, that's different." "What's the difference?" "Xiao Zhou from class six has a chef's certificate, so he will be in our cooking class in the future..." "So.So you can turn a blind eye, so you can treat them differently, so the one who worked all afternoon and tidied the warehouse is a thief, but the other one is not?" The chief of staff opened the door and raised the door instantly. Liu Cheng quickly shut up and did not dare to speak anymore.He patted his heart and said heartbrokenly: "Comrades, I am very heartbroken, I am very sad!" "Just for such a trivial matter, you forced a recruit to be pinned down in the corner of the garbage dump and searched him with his hands. How is this different from a street gangster?" "You all need to reflect on it, especially you!" Liu Cheng is a mute who eats Coptis chinensis and can't tell the pain.I thought I would be praised and rewarded, but I didn't expect to be scolded.The other veterans who had suffered unreasonable disasters hated this guy now. If he hadn't screamed that he had stolen something, how would they have chased him?But one thing they still can't figure out is who stole the things hidden in the jar?The chief of staff asked: "By the way, you said you lost something earlier, what was it?" The cooking squad leader said quickly: "Several mobile phones, MP4 players, and two packs of cigarettes." "Didn't you hand in all these things? Why do you still have them?" "Well, this..." The veterans hesitated, obviously nervous and guilty.The chief of staff sneered and immediately understood that these guys had all illegally hidden electronic products.No wonder everyone was so excited before. This was because they were afraid that something would happen and they would be scolded by the company commander and instructor."Where are the things hidden and how did they get lost?" "We hid all the things in the kimchi jar in the warehouse, and they were gone in the blink of an eye." "Kimchi jar, which kimchi jar?" "It's the dozen jars with pickled radish and pickles in the corner., Aren’t there a few that are vacant?We put everything that cannot be seen in the light, that’s how we escaped the last time the regimental deputy committee member came to check.”When the chief of staff heard this, he was stunned for a moment, and then he smacked his head and jumped anxiously."Oh, you guys, you guys, you really made me miserable!" "I went to deliver pickles to the regiment leaders in the afternoon, so I just picked up two jars and left!" "What? You, you gave them to the regiment leaders???" The veterans were confused and asked which leader of the regiment they were given to, and whether they could get them back?The chief secretary scratched his head and scratched his head anxiously. He just sent it and asked to come back. Doesn't that mean there is no three hundred taels of silver in this place?But in the end, he chose to take a gamble and planned to visit again to see if he could get the pickles back because they had gone bad and were not pickled properly.Just as the division chief and the cooking squad leader drove over slowly and hurriedly, they were in the duty room on the second floor of the regiment headquarters.Tan Yuanzhou, the deputy commissioner in charge of combat readiness duty, was holding porridge in one hand and chopsticks in the other.When I saw the mobile phone and MP4 in the kimchi jar, I had a strange, incomprehensible, yet shocked expression...
